description: This file defines the ImapHandlerInterface interface, which specifies a set of methods for managing and interacting with an IMAP email server. It includes method signatures for common email operations such as connecting, fetching messages, managing mailboxes, and error handling.

classes.name: ImapHandlerInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines the methods required for an IMAP handler class to implement, including functionalities like connecting, fetching emails, managing mailboxes, and error handling.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IMAP service is available.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Verifies if the provided stream resource is valid.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message encountered.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a mailbox connection with specified credentials and options.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a mailbox with specific options.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout on the connection.

methods.name: getMailboxes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of mailboxes matching a reference and pattern.

methods.name: getMessageNo
methods.description: Gets the message sequence number for a given UID.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Fetches header info for a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID for a message.

methods.name: getNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns the number of messages in the current mailbox.

methods.name: fetchStructure
methods.description: Retrieves the structure of a message.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Fetches the body of a message.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets status information for a mailbox.

methods.name: utf8
methods.description: Converts MIME encoded text to UTF-8.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches a part of the message body.

methods.name: rfc822ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses raw headers into an object.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a command check on the connection.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages matching criteria with sorting and pagination.
